ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75-80% high-intensity white coverage in the central field and 20-25% low-intensity black coverage along the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area; solid black pigmentation at the distal tips; black mottling and vertical streaking extending from the trailing edge into the white field; single high-contrast dark circular spot on the lower-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with frequent peaks and valleys; higher amplitude serrations observed on the inner margins near the notch; low-amplitude jaggedness along the remainder of the edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge boundary terminating in sharply upturned, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular dark pixel cluster located in the lower-right quadrant of the white ventral surface; scattered low-density dark speckling near the black-white boundary transitions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned brownish-orange linear marks visible on the white surface of the right lobe, primarily diagonal in orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a prominent, isolated circular dark mark (puncture or lesion) on the right fluke lobe.
